sn20.9:1.3: tena kho pana samayena aññataro navo bhikkhu ativelaṃ kulāni upasaṅkamati.
sn20.9:1.7: “imehi nāma therā bhikkhū kulāni upasaṅkamitabbaṃ maññissanti, kimaṅgapanāha”nti.
sn20.9:2.1: atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
sn20.9:2.2: idha bhante aññataro navo bhikkhu ativelaṃ kulāni upasaṅkamati.
sn20.9:2.6: “imehi nāma therā bhikkhū kulāni upasaṅkamitabbaṃ maññissanti, kimaṅgapanāha”nti.
sn20.9:3.3: te taṃ sarasiṃ ogāhetvā soṇḍāya bhisamulālaṃ abbhūggahetvā suvikkhālitaṃ vikkhāletvā akaddamaṃ saṅkhāditvā ajjhoharanti.
sn20.9:3.4: tesaṃ taṃ vaṇṇāya ceva hoti balāya ca. na ca tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigacchanti maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ.
sn20.9:3.5: tesaññeva kho pana bhikkhave, mahānāgānaṃ anusikkhamānā taruṇā bhiṃkacchāpā, te taṃ sarasiṃ ogāhetvā soṇḍāya bhisamulālaṃ abbuggahetvā na suvikkhālitaṃ vikkhāletvā sakaddamaṃ asaṅkhāditvā ajjhoharanti.
sn20.9:3.6: tesaṃ taṃ neva vaṇṇāya hoti na balāya.
sn20.9:3.7: tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigacchanti, maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ.
sn20.9:4.1: evameva kho bhikkhave, idha therā bhikkhū pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pavisanti.
sn20.9:4.4: te taṃ lābhaṃ agathitā amucchitā anajjhopannaṃ, ādīnavadassāvino nissaraṇapaññā paribhuñjanti.
sn20.9:4.5: tesaṃ taṃ vaṇṇāya ceva hoti balāya ca, na ca tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigacchanti, maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ.
sn20.9:4.6: tesaññeva kho pana bhikkhave, therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ anusikkhamānā navā bhikkhū pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pavisanti.
sn20.9:4.9: te taṃ lābhaṃ gathitā mucchitā ajjhopannā anādīnavadassāvino anissaraṇapaññā paribhuñjanti.
sn20.9:4.10: tesaṃ taṃ neva vaṇṇāya hoti na balāya. te tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigacchanti, maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ.
sn20.9:4.12: “agathitā amucchitā anajjhopannā ādīnavadassāvino nissaraṇapaññā lābhaṃ paribhuñjissāmā”ti.
